questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs the equation will be correct?

43 + 18 ÷ 9 x 4 - 3 = 87
questions.solution:
Here if we interchange + and × we will get the answer as 87.

43 + 18 ÷ 9 x 4 - 3 = 48, to get 87 we need to perform like

43 × 18 ÷ 9 + 4 - 3 = 87.

questions.question:
If 5 @ 3 @ 1 = 3 and 9 @ 6 @ 1 = 4, then

9 @ 5 @ 1 = ?
questions.solution:
Here @ can be either + or -, like

5 @ 3 @ 1 = 3

5 - 3 + 1 = 3

9 @ 6 @ 1 = 4

9 - 6 + 1 = 4

Similarly,

9 @ 5 @ 1 = ?

9 - 5 + 1 = 5

Hence, 5 Is correct answer.

questions.question: Present ages of M and N are in the ratio 7 : 8 respectively. After five years this ratio becomes 8 : 9. What is the present age (in years) of M?
questions.solution:
Let us consider the age of M and N to be 7x : 8x, after 5 years there age will be (7x + 5) and (8x + 5) which is equal to ratio 8 : 9.

So by comparing that we will get,

(7x + 5) : (8x + 5) ∷ 8 : 9

⇒ 9(7x + 5) = 8 (8x + 5)

⇒ 63x + 45 = 64x + 40

⇒ 45 - 40 = 64x - 63x

⇒ x = 5

Therefore x = 5, then the age of M will be 7x = 7 × 5 = 35.

Hence, 35 is the correct answer.

questions.question: N remembers his birthday is before 16th December. N's brother remembers his birthday is after 14th December. On which date of December is his birthday?
questions.solution:
As per given data N remembers his birthday is before 16th December which may be either 14th or 15th. But N’s mother remembers her son’s birthday is after 14th which may be either 15th or 16th. So, we can consider his birthday is on 15th December because it comes after 14th December and before 16th December.

Hence, 15 is correct.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some plates are cups.

II. All cups are red.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some plates are red.

II. All plates are red.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff86ddb78561ed92b06d6067924716481bbc5c4cfab0b65c29ef2c288745e509.png] 

I. Some plates are red →True

II. All plates are red → False (As per the given statements we can consider some plates are cups and all cups are red. Hence, we can consider some plates are red. )

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: In a certain code language, "MAN" is written as "56" and "WAN" is written as "76". How is "OPT" written in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a245bbea30b84a7ac20a4d4605b68c55e76c9a0c62b389481799794a50b0e025.png] 

MAN = M + A + N = 13 + 1 + 14 = 28 + 28 = 56

WAN = W + A + N = 23 + 1 + 14 = 38 + 38 = 76

Similarly, OPT = O + P + T = 15 + 16 + 20 = 51 + 51 = 102.

Hence, the correct answer is 102.
